summary: The text discusses various FCC E-Rate comments and their implications on the program. It mentions concerns about screen-time limits, parental autonomy, and the role of the government in regulating online content for schools.

claims.argument: Screen-time limits could increase costs for schools
claims.evidence_quote: Parents must be able to understand how online content is evaluated by schools, what types of material are restricted or permitted, and how parents can raise concerns.
